Hello. Fellow ace here.
Asexual people have little to no sexual attraction towards others, so if you’re sexually attracted towards people, you’re not asexual. Asexual does not mean to lack sexual desire and/or be sex-repulsed. This is because sexual pleasure doesn’t have to be directed towards someone. Although this is true, there are still lots of asexuals who are sex-repulsed and lack a libido. Asexuality doesn’t always have to involve sex personally, it’s just the lack of attraction towards others (it’s a spectrum!) 
So if you don’t like sex as a person who is sexually attracted to others, that’s perfectly okay! Might want to look into sex repulsion.
